integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the exact area, total-mean-curvature, quotient, minimization, and stability formulas. The expansion is reconstructed from the published reparameterized quotient formula and independently replayed symbolically from the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local expansion of the Minkowski quotient along the canonical one-parameter Pansu-Minkowski family. It does not give a global quadratic stability constant on the whole parameter interval and does not address unrestricted nonsymmetric perturbations.
title: Exact local stability and cubic skew of the optimal Pansu-Minkowski sphere
